title: Binary Tree Level Order Traversal
constraints: Tree is given as a level-order array; use -1 to represent null nodes
description:
Given the root of a binary tree (as a **level-order array**), return the **level order traversal** of its nodes' values (i.e., from left to right, level by level) as a 2D array.

**Tree encoding:** Nodes are in BFS order. Use `-1` for null nodes.

```text
Input:  [3, 9, 20, -1, -1, 15, 7]

        3          <- level 0
       / \
      9  20        <- level 1
        /  \
       15   7      <- level 2

Output: [[3], [9, 20], [15, 7]]
```

tests.explanation: Three levels: root [3], second level [9,20], third level [15,7].
